# SuperPrint @VERSION@

Three desktop apps: **SuperPrint** (layout, prepress, CMYK, PDF export),
**Studio IA** (the AI composes a layout from one sentence), **SuperTyPo**
(redraw a typeface, character by character, and export it).
**Free · no account · offline once installed.**

The **21 files below** are the downloads — their names never change.
[All versions](https://github.com/zigmoon/SUPERPRINT/releases) ·
[Download page](https://superprint.cc/) ·
[Web app](https://superprint.cc/app/index.html) ·
[Changelog](https://app.zigmoon.com/release.html) · <contact@superprint.cc>

**Install** — Windows: `.exe` or `.msi`. Linux: `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage`.
macOS: `.dmg`, drag to *Applications*. Not notarised by Apple: if the first
launch is blocked, right-click the app → **Open**.
